---
title: "Cluster detection, live --- heart disease deaths in Michigan, 2000--2023"
output:
  flexdashboard::flex_dashboard:
    orientation: columns
    vertical_layout: fill
    theme: cosmo
    source_code: embed
runtime: shiny
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(flexdashboard)
library(shiny)
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)
library(leaflet)
library(DT)
library(tigris)
library(SpatialEpi)                           
options(tigris_use_cache = TRUE)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)


mi_raw <- read_csv("COUNTandPOP2000to2023.csv",
                   col_types = cols(County = col_character()))


mi_map <- counties(state = "MI", cb = TRUE, year = 2020,
                   progress_bar = FALSE) |>
  st_transform(4326) |>                          # leaflet wants lon/lat
  arrange(GEOID)


county_ids <- mi_map |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  transmute(GEOID, county = NAME)

mi <- mi_raw |>
  filter(County != "Michigan") |>
  pivot_longer(cols = `2000`:`2023`,
               names_to = "year", values_to = "Y") |>
  mutate(year = as.integer(year),
         county = County) |>
  select(county, year, Y, population = Population) |>
  left_join(county_ids, by = "county") |>
  select(GEOID, county, year, Y, population)


if (anyNA(mi$GEOID)) {
  stop("Some county names in the CSV did not match the Michigan county boundaries: ",
       paste(unique(mi$county[is.na(mi$GEOID)]), collapse = ", "))
}

# County centroids
cen <- st_geometry(mi_map) |> st_transform(5070) |> st_centroid()
ll  <- st_coordinates(st_transform(cen, 4326))  
km  <- st_coordinates(cen) / 1000                
dist_km <- as.matrix(dist(km))                   
# The scan, as in the SaTScan lecture
run_scan <- function(d, max_window, reps) {
  set.seed(374)
  kd <- kulldorff(geo             = km,
                  cases           = d$Y,
                  population      = d$population,
                  expected.cases  = d$E,         # Poisson model
                  pop.upper.bound = max_window / 100,
                  n.simulations   = reps,
                  alpha.level     = 1,           # list every cluster
                  plot            = FALSE)
  cl <- c(list(kd$most.likely.cluster), kd$secondary.clusters)
  cl <- Filter(function(x) x$log.likelihood.ratio > 0, cl)   # clusters with an excess
  C  <- sum(d$Y)

  clusters <- NULL                              
  members  <- NULL                               
  for (k in seq_along(cl)) {
    x   <- cl[[k]]
    ids <- x$location.IDs.included             
    o   <- x$number.of.cases
    e   <- x$expected.cases
    dc  <- dist_km[ids[1], ]                    
    clusters <- rbind(clusters, data.frame(
      cluster   = k,
      counties  = paste(sort(d$county[ids]), collapse = ", "),
      n         = length(ids),
      lon       = ll[ids[1], "X"],              
      lat       = ll[ids[1], "Y"],
      radius_km = round(max(dc[ids]), 1),        
      circle_km = (max(dc[ids]) + min(dc[-ids])) / 2,  
      observed  = o,
      expected  = round(e),
      O_E       = round(o / e, 2),              
      RR        = round((o / e) / ((C - o) / (C - e)), 2), 
      LLR       = round(x$log.likelihood.ratio, 1),
      p         = x$p.value))
    members <- rbind(members, data.frame(GEOID = d$GEOID[ids], cluster = k,
                                         p = x$p.value))
  }
  list(clusters = clusters, members = members)
}

breaks <- c(0, 0.5, 2/3, 0.9, 1/0.9, 1.5, 2, Inf)   # Exercise 4 classes
```

Column {.sidebar data-width=260}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

```{r inputs}
sliderInput("years", "Years", min = 2000, max = 2023,
            value = c(2000, 2023), step = 1, sep = "")
sliderInput("max_window", "Maximum window (% of population)",
            min = 5, max = 50, value = 50, step = 5, post = "%")
radioButtons("reps", "Monte Carlo replications",
             c("99", "999"), selected = "999", inline = TRUE)
selectInput("alpha", "Map clusters with p below",
            c("0.01", "0.05", "0.10"), selected = "0.05")
```

A purely spatial Poisson scan for high heart disease death rates, with
`kulldorff()`. It reruns about a second after you change a setting.

On the map, black outline: counties in a cluster with p below the cut-off;
dashed circle: its scanning window.

Expected cases: Michigan's rate in the selected years times each county's
population exposure, as in Exercise 4. The CSV supplies one population value
per county rather than annual populations, so that value is treated as a
constant annual population and multiplied by the number of selected years
(person-years) when calculating expected deaths.

```{r reactive}
years <- debounce(reactive(input$years), 1000)   # wait for the slider to stop

# Deaths and population exposure by county, selected years
by_county <- reactive({
  req(years())
  mi |>
    filter(between(year, years()[1], years()[2])) |>
    group_by(GEOID, county) |>
    summarise(Y = sum(Y),
              population = sum(population),
              .groups = "drop") |>
    mutate(E   = sum(Y) / sum(population) * population,   # expected
           SIR = Y / E)
})

# The scan: reruns when a setting changes
results <- reactive({
  withProgress(message = "Running the scan...", {
    run_scan(by_county(), input$max_window, as.integer(input$reps))
  })
})
```

Column {data-width=600}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### SIR and clusters, selected years

```{r map}
renderLeaflet({
  alpha <- as.numeric(input$alpha)
  sig   <- filter(results()$clusters, p < alpha) # clusters below the cut-off
  d <- mi_map |>
    left_join(by_county(), by = "GEOID") |>
    left_join(results()$members, by = "GEOID")   # cluster and p, or NA
  pal <- colorBin(rev(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(7, "RdBu")),
                  domain = d$SIR, bins = breaks)

  m <- leaflet(d) |>
    addProviderTiles("OpenStreetMap") |>
    addPolygons(fillColor = ~pal(SIR), fillOpacity = 0.8,
                color = "white", weight = 1,
                label = ~sprintf("%s: SIR %.2f, cluster %s", NAME, SIR,
                                 ifelse(is.na(cluster), "none", cluster))) |>
    addLegend("bottomright", pal = pal, values = ~SIR,
              title = paste0("SIR<br>", years()[1], "-", years()[2]),
              labFormat = labelFormat(digits = 2), opacity = 0.8)

  if (nrow(sig) > 0) {
    m <- m |>
      addPolygons(data = filter(d, p < alpha),   # counties in those clusters
                  fill = FALSE, color = "black", weight = 1,
                  group = "Cluster outlines") |>
      addCircles(data = sig, lng = ~lon, lat = ~lat,
                 radius = ~1000 * circle_km,     # km to metres
                 fill = FALSE, color = "#333333", weight = 1.5,
                 dashArray = "6 4", group = "Scanning circles") |>
      addLabelOnlyMarkers(data = sig, lng = ~lon, lat = ~lat,
                          label = ~as.character(cluster),
                          labelOptions = labelOptions(noHide = TRUE,
                                                      direction = "center"),
                          group = "Scanning circles") |>
      addLayersControl(overlayGroups = c("Cluster outlines", "Scanning circles"),
                       options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE))  # checkboxes
  }
  m
})
```

Column {data-width=400}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Clusters below the cut-off

```{r box-n}
renderValueBox({
  n <- sum(results()$clusters$p < as.numeric(input$alpha))
  valueBox(n, caption = paste("clusters with p <", input$alpha),
           icon = "fa-bullseye", color = if (n > 0) "primary" else "#5A6472")
})
```

### Most likely cluster

```{r box-mlc}
renderValueBox({
  clusters <- results()$clusters
  if (is.null(clusters) || nrow(clusters) == 0) {
    valueBox("None", icon = "fa-crosshairs",
             caption = "no excess-risk cluster detected",
             color = "#5A6472")
  } else {
    top <- clusters[1, ]                         # cluster 1
    valueBox(sprintf("RR %.2f", top$RR), icon = "fa-crosshairs",
             caption = sprintf("most likely cluster: %d counties, p = %s",
                               top$n, top$p),
             color = "#5A6472")
  }
})
```

### Clusters

```{r table}
renderDT({
  results()$clusters |>
    select(-lon, -lat, -circle_km) |>            # map-only columns off the table
    datatable(rownames = FALSE, options = list(pageLength = 6, dom = "tp"))
})
```
